observations.note: About 60 poll calls (git log -1 plus reading the background output file) waited on a slow 71-test run; the run should be bounded or given a blocking wait instead of polling at high context.
Roughly 120k tokens were loaded before the first write and 159 turns ran above 200k context, so the long polling phase paid for a very large context each time.
Step 7 (search the spec folders for behaviours the changed files make false) was not run, and the final note admits it.
Step 8 asks for one edit marking all rows, but the plan was edited about ten times, one per row.
The agent used pipes, 2>&1, heredocs and a shell grep despite the plain-single-command rule; two were refused by the permission layer.
The worktree stamp test failed through repeated edit-and-rerun cycles on the test file, with extra engine reads in between, before it passed.

conformance.item: Write the phase's tests before changing source files
Run only the test files the rows name
Step 7: check specs outside the plan that the change touches
Step 8: write completed marks in one edit of the plan
Use plain single commands, no pipes or redirections
No git commit, push or gh
